title: Legacy Model Lifecycle Management
business: Enterprise software teams maintaining long-running AI integrations
problem: Applications relying on retired models like Claude 2.1 face service interruptions because requests to retired models will fail.
solution: Implement a proactive model auditing and migration workflow to transition from legacy models to active, supported versions.
steps: Navigate to the Usage page in the Claude Console to audit current model deployments.
Export the usage CSV to identify specific API keys still invoking the claude-2.1 endpoint.
Map the identified legacy model to its recommended replacement, such as claude-opus-4-8.
Update application code to point to the new model identifier and perform regression testing.
Monitor the production environment to ensure all traffic has successfully shifted away from the retired model.
outcome: Continuous service availability and alignment with current model support standards.
limitation: Performance characteristics may vary between model generations; check this by conducting thorough testing of applications with the new models well before the retirement date.
